sentence.en: Revenue for 25 Sep–22 Oct 2026: 7.63M TL. Organic search leads at 2.43M TL, then Direct 1.67M TL and Google Ads 1.64M TL. Autumn sale starts (10 Oct, a campaign) falls in this period and lines up with the higher days after it.

interpretation.en: Read as: revenue, by channel, 25 Sep–22 Oct 2026.

query.sql:
-- metric revenue v2
SELECT
  channel,
  SUM(revenue) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY value DESC

comparison.sql:
-- metric revenue v2
SELECT
  channel,
  SUM(revenue) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-28' AND DATE '2026-09-24'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY value DESC
